Hydrozoa

A self-hosted Git Multipoint Mirror Agent for synchronizing repositories, issues, and metadata across multiple providers with a bioluminescent deep-sea aesthetic.

Get Started View on GitHub

Overview

Hydrozoa is designed to be a lightweight, robust, and visually stunning agent that keeps your Git repositories in sync across different platforms like GitHub and GitLab. Whether you're looking for redundancy, migration, or multi-cloud availability, Hydrozoa provides the tentacles to reach all your nodes.

Multipoint Sync

Synchronize a single source to multiple targets simultaneously.

Bioluminescent UI

A deep-sea inspired dashboard for real-time telemetry and monitoring.

Self-Hosted

Full control over your data and synchronization logic.
